purpose: T1.8 production stamp + noise-floor re-measurement at the production parallel config

config.note: First bench at the true FOGGIE production config; earlier benches (t19-manual, T1.9 stamp) ran 512 ranks on 4 x rom_ait, an accidental make_bench_run.py default. Noise floors are config-specific, so the floor was re-measured here.

noise_floor.summary: Identical-code divergence at 1x128 mil_ait grows ~1 decade per root step; envelope at step 5 (DD0399): baryon 2.9e-8, metal 1.4e-7, stellar 2.6e-8, +-1 star event, structure diverges at DD0399. Wall-clock noise ~0.5%. Single-pair floors scatter by ~5x at step 5 (A1-A2 baryon 5.8e-9 vs A2-A3 2.9e-8) - use the multi-pair envelope (merge_noise_floors.py).

verdict.result: PASS at class C0 with the 3-pair envelope floor (gates = max(1e-12, 10x envelope)); worst margin DD0399 baryon_mass 9.455e-08 vs gate 2.894e-07. Structure/star-count deltas within the floor divergence regime. Wall-clock ratio A1/B = 0.999.
verdict.note: Against the single-pair A1-A2 floor, A1-vs-B tripped only DD0399 baryon (9.5e-8 vs 5.8e-8 gate); the A1-A2 step-5 baryon sample proved an outlier vs the other pairs, motivating the envelope.

instrumentation_first_production_numbers.wall_clock: candidate 2414.1 s vs baseline 2412.9 s over 5 root cycles - zero measurable overhead (0.05%, noise 0.5%)
instrumentation_first_production_numbers.dt_limiter: Baryons (CFL) is the binding dt constraint on every level in every root cycle; L10 runs ~410-460 subcycles per root cycle
instrumentation_first_production_numbers.mg_solver: 1.29-1.42M subgrid solves per root cycle, avg 1.18-1.20 V-cycles, zero fallbacks
instrumentation_first_production_numbers.scaling_observation: 5 root steps take ~2413 s at 128 ranks vs ~2360 s at 512 ranks: 4x cores bought ~2% - the audit's strong-scaling ceiling measured directly at the anchor
